informal_statement: The angular type-\(\mathrm B\) weighted perimeter is \(2((\pi-\beta)r+\lambda\alpha)\), with \(\alpha=\beta+\arccos\lambda\) and \(r=\sin\alpha/\sin\beta\).
reason: `CMVBallDefinitions.lean:18-21`: The formal total expression is \(2\cdot ((\pi -\beta )\cdot r+\lambda \cdot \alpha )\). The source's exterior and unit-circle arc lengths yield exactly these weights, including density \(\lambda\) on the closed unit-circle boundary.
